items.title: Email Campaign · : 1-Year Annual Service (28 candidates)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 28 clients whose install anniversary hits this week
**Timing:** Tuesday, May 6, 9:00 AM ET
**Expected performance:** 55% open / 8% click / 18% booking (5 appointments)
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`Your system's 1-year checkup (free under warranty)`
**Alternates:**
1. `12 months in: here's what happens next`
2. `Annual service window opens this week`
3. `The only maintenance your system needs`
4. `One year down. Here's year two.`
**Preview text:**
`Takes 45 min. Catches the two things that go wrong. Already covered.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** Your system's 1-year checkup (free under warranty)
Hi {{firstName}},
Your {{system_name}} just hit its first birthday.
That means it's time for the only required maintenance: the annual service visit.
**What we do:**
Check system pressure and flow rate. Inspect seals and valve operation. Test water quality pre and post treatment. Swap any media or cartridges that need it (covered under your warranty). Document everything in Jobber so you have a service history.
Takes about 45 minutes. Finds the two things that typically need adjustment at 12 months (resin bed settling, pressure drop from sediment).
**Your install date:** {{install_date}}
**Your system:** {{system_name}}
**Service window:** Now through June 5
Reply to this email or text me at 757.340.0727 with two dates that work. We'll lock it in.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md § Jobber lifecycle automations:** "1-year annual service reminder" is the #1 highest-value trigger. These customers are contractually owed a service visit, already trust us, and need a simple nudge.
- **Voice calibration:** Killing Bad Water Sales register is internal only. This is a post-sale operational email, so tone is **concise, professional, transactional** (neither luxury nor sales-aggressive). Short sentences. No hype. Factual benefit statements.
- **Hard Rule compliance:** No Concierge pitch (these are AT 12 months, not past it). System name dynamically inserted per customer record (Pro Ultra + RO, FerroMax + Neumax + RO PRO QC, etc.). Signoff is two lines, no em dash.
---

items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (13 candidates, 30; 60 days post-install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 13 satisfied clients in the "honeymoon window" (system is new, excitement is high, haven't been asked yet)
**Timing:** Thursday, May 8, 11:00 AM ET
**Expected performance:** 48% open / 4% click / 2 referrals submitted (15% referral conversion rate among openers)
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`The $500 question I should've asked sooner`
**Alternates:**
1. `Quick: do you know 2 people with bad water?`
2. `I'll pay you $500 if they say yes`
3. `Most lucrative email I'll send you this year`
4. `Your neighbors are asking about your water`
**Preview text:**
`You get $500 cash when they buy. $50 gift card if they just book a consult. Here's how.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** The $500 question I should've asked sooner
Hi {{firstName}},
Two months ago we installed your {{system_name}}.
I'm guessing at least one neighbor, family member, or coworker has asked you about it by now. (Most clients tell us someone notices the water within the first 30 days.)
So here's the question I should have asked at install: **do you know anyone else dealing with hard water, iron staining, chlorine taste, or well water issues?**
If yes, and they book a free water assessment with us, you get a **$50 gift card** when they show up.
If they move forward and we install a system, you get **$500 cash** (referrals 1; 5 this year), **$750** (referrals 6; 9), or **$1,000** (referral 10+).
**How it works:**
Reply to this email with their first name and phone number. I'll text them, mention you referred them, and offer a free water assessment. If they book, you get the $50 card. If they buy, you get the cash within 7 days of their install.
That's it. No forms, no tracking links, no waiting 90 days.
You've got exceptional water now. If someone you know is still dealing with hard water buildup, sulfur smell, or buying bottled water by the pallet, send them my way.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
P.S. We also pay $250 if you record a 60-second video testimonial we can use on Instagram or our website. (Way more valuable to us than a Google review.) Let me know if you're up for it and I'll send you the three questions to answer on camera.
---
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md § Jobber lifecycle automations:** "Referral request (30; 60d post-install, high satisfaction)" is a top-3 trigger. Timing is optimal (system is working, excitement hasn't worn off, they haven't been asked yet).
- **Hard Rule #3:** No review requests. Push referrals (with exact bonus structure: $500 / $750 / $1k cash, $50 consult card) and video testimonials ($250). Both present.
- **Hard Rule #3a:** Offer phrasing is "free water assessment" (used twice), never "free water test."
- **Voice:** This is a **sales/persuasion** email but sent to existing clients, so it lives between luxury product and Killing Bad Water Sales. Tone is conversational, benefit-forward, removes friction ("no forms, no tracking links"). Specificity builds trust ($500 exact, 7-day payout, 60-second video).
- **Personalization:** {{system_name}} = "Clearwave Sovereign + RO Pure PRO QC" for Ashley, "Reionator Pro Ultra + RO" for Nicole, "H2O Protector" for Devin, etc. For Matthew Kennedy (system not specified), it becomes "your ClearWave system" per Hard Rule #2.
---
## Why These Two (and Not the Others)
| Campaign | Conversion Probability | Revenue Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1-year service** | HIGH (contractual obligation, already owed) | $0 revenue but critical for retention, warranty compliance, and future Concierge upsell | LOW (existing list, simple ask) |
| **Referral push** | MEDIUM-HIGH (honeymoon period, haven't been asked) | $500; $1k per closed referral = $10k; $20k potential pipeline from 13 clients | LOW (personalized mail merge) |
| RO replacement cycle | LOW (6; 12mo early for most; only 5 are at true 12mo RO mark) | ~$400/unit but mistimed | MED |
| Concierge upsell (100 candidates) | MEDIUM (valuable but colder audience, longer sales cycle) | $99/mo × 10 conversions = $11,880 ARR | MED-HIGH (requires math-heavy education) |
| Cold lead re-engagement (1000) | LOW (60+ days cold, no quote ever issued) | Unknown (top-of-funnel) | HIGH (needs new content hook, separate nurture sequence) |
**Decision:**
- **1-year service = must-do operational revenue protection.** These clients are owed a visit. If we don't proactively book them, they forget, warranty lapses, and we lose the Concierge upsell opportunity at 18 months. High open rate expected (55%+) because it's timely and relevant.
- **Referral push = highest ROI for effort.** 13 happy clients, never asked, in the optimal window. Even 2 referrals = $8k; $24k pipeline. Low lift, high upside.
**Concierge upsell** is valuable but better suited for a **standalone sequence next week** (longer educational arc, needs social proof and cost-benefit breakdown). The 100-person list is large enough to justify a dedicated 2-email sequence rather than a one-shot campaign.
**Cold leads (1,000)** need a **content-first re-engagement** (e.g., "the Maryland jet fuel leak story + here's what it means for your water + we're still here if you want that free assessment"). But this is a separate nurture track, not a quick-win lifecycle trigger. Propose separately if you want a cold-lead thaw campaign.
